title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 3�<6 hrs | Sister City + Fallback | Cash
description:
Tests Sister City rebooking and a Fallback code together, with a controllable cause. AC 442 YUL?YYZ was delayed because its inbound aircraft arrived late for a reason within AC's control (upline, code 05). The customer accepted rebooking to AC 444 YUL?YHM (Hamilton, sister city of YYZ). The arrival delay code is missing, so DDS falls back to departure delay code 05. Checks five things: (1) Sister City = TRUE, (2) Fallback = TRUE, (3) both flags are set together, (4) delay = actual arrival at YHM minus the original promised arrival at YYZ (5 hours), and (5) code 05 is Controllable, so Tier 1 pays CAD 400 by Interac.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC077: one passenger, Isabelle C�t� (Adult). Original flight: AC 442 YUL?YYZ, May 15, 2026, scheduled arrival 12:00 at YYZ, DELAYED. Cancellation code: NONE. Arrival delay code: NULL (missing). First departure delay code: 05 (upline, within carrier control), used as fallback. The customer accepted INVOL rebooking to AC 444 YUL?YHM, which arrived at 17:00 at YHM. Delay: 17:00 (YHM) ? 12:00 (YYZ) = 5 hours. Sister city pair: YHM ? YYZ. Fallback: TRUE. Aeroplan: not linked. CyberSource set to GREEN. Persona set to IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD, Interac). Regime: APPR. More than 72 hours have passed. Filed after 31 days, within 366 days.
